_about: ORW-509 ratchet for the non-character world lists. Measured over 60 seeded seasons by scripts/probes/worldPoolMeasure.ts (the full 200-season table is in the PR). `maxWithin`: share of a season's draws that repeat an earlier draw of the same season. `minAcross`: distinct values over all seasons. `maxNext`: share of a season's values that the next season also has. A list that gets worse than its ceiling fails; a fix lowers the ceiling in the same PR. `before200` is the base commit's value over 200 seasons, kept for the record. Lists left out are closed mechanic ids (tie natures, finale appeals, goodbye tones, exit stances) or next-PR lists (see `open`).

open.competition mechanics: 30 mechanics (12 + 18); a season uses nearly all, so consecutive seasons share about 90 percent. Next PR: grow the library and let the writer author a mechanic variant per season.
open.house theme (id): 24 library themes; no season memory input is wired to a front-end ledger yet. With memory the next-season share is 0.
open.house room names: 13 names per library theme (24 themes). The writer-authored house (acceptHouseThemeDraft, this PR) replaces this once the front end authors one per season (next PR).
open.tie natures: 11 mechanic keys; next PR adds an authored tie story beside the key.
open.gossip hedge / off-screen verbs: cosmetic, stripped or rewritten before display; widened by composition only.
